cohort: 31 pregnant women admitted with liver disorders unique to pregnancy (IHCP, HELLP, AFLP) between January 2008 and December 2013
finding: Out of 31 pregnant women with liver disorders unique to pregnancy, there were 7 perinatal deaths and one maternal death due to AFLP.
mod_finding: 17 patients delivered vaginally, while 14 underwent cesarean delivery; all women with AFLP had vaginal deliveries due to operative and anesthesia risks.
